facts.claim: Recovery point objective (RPO) is the maximum acceptable data loss, measured backward in time from the failure to the last good copy; a zero RPO needs synchronous replication.
With synchronous replication a commit is acknowledged only after a standby confirms it, so every commit pays at least one network round trip.
A hot site is continuously replicated and can take over in minutes; recovery time depends on the site tier.

simplifications: Ledgerline is an invented example system. Every number is an assumed teaching value, not a measurement.
The simulator uses 5 microseconds per kilometer one way and ignores queuing, routing detours and jitter.
The failover time budget is a design budget, not a test result.
